what: ConocoPhillips is the largest independent oil and gas producer: it explores and pumps but does not refine or run fuel stations. Its core is US shale, with assets in Alaska, Canada, Norway and Qatar LNG.
money: shale oil and gas in the Permian, Eagle Ford and Bakken
moat: A large inventory of low-cost drilling locations and disciplined returns of cash to shareholders.
opportunities: Low-cost shale and Alaskan positions with decades of inventory
A dividend yield around 2.7% plus variable returns when prices are high
watch: Production volumes and free cash flow per share.
